title: guns over bows
description: this resource pack is for people that want guns in minecraft
body:
Why would you want to download this resorse pack?

haven't you ever wanted guns in minecraft? I did and I spent a lot of my free time to make this resorse pack! I like it and I hope you like it to!

what this resorse pack changes: 

This resorse pack changes the bow texture to a gun texture 

This resorse pack changes the arrow texture to a bullet texture

This resorse pack changes the text of the arrow to bullet

This resorse pack changes the text of the bow to gun
